title: Default Bowls
description: The default Minecraft bowls for compatibility purposes
body: After making the Default Buckets resource pack because of the incompatibility with Fresh Textures buckets and Create mod add-on buckets, I realised that Farmer's Delight was full of meals with bowls that looked totally different from Fresh Textures bowls. Doing literally the same thing I did for Default Buckets, I quickly whipped up Default Bowls. My genius is truly unmatched.
